title: Physics platformer where you play as shapeshifting water
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
EBB is my new 3D physics platformer where you adapt your water composition based on what's happening in the game, and the challenges in front of you - so kinda like Zelda temples except you play as a water character  
  
Progress through the game while shifting your water based form:  
• Puddle: slip under gates, ride glass tubes and shoot back up like a geyser  
• Ice: hold down plates, slide over hot floors and smash through glass  
• Vapor: float on warm air and squeeze between bars  
  
I've made four maps so far, and adding new ones based on early player feedback   
  
So far I'm 260 prompts deep, and it's only 190 KB big :)  


What should I add next?

comments.author: TriggerHydrant
comments.body:
Tried, it like it a lot! Got two things tho: the walking sometimes looks and feels like 'gliding' on the floor, makes me feel 'too flowy' and not as connected to the world as I  like to be. I like the 'fluid feel' to be inside of the mechanics and puzzles and not in the walking. (I'm sliding over the floor and it's always a couple of seconds behind it seems, on Chrome and powerful Macbook)  
  
Frames dip randomly, when it runs smooth it's great but when it dips it takes me out of the freeflow feel that water provides and I think that working on performance really will give it that extra polish and love.

The mechanics are clever, the tutorial is great (lots of games miss this) and I wanna applaud you for creating this, keep on going because I think you can def make this a full game!!
